preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.
The length of strings A and B must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrst' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrst' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B must consist only of the first 20 lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(moves) if moves != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest number of moves to make A equal to B, or -1 if it is impossible.
